head: codex/5912-runtime-birth-witness
title: [v0.92][runtime][birth-witness] Add production policy and receipt boundary
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5912

## Summary
- seal the four-role birth-witness trust manifest inside validated Runtime credential initialization
- retain a Runtime-owned operator in production serve that provisions opaque policy and invokes build, reconstruction validation, canonical staging, and commit
- prevent library/request callers from constructing authority roots or redirecting the validated trust path
- preserve guardian and lifecycle-soak Runtime configuration consumers

## Validation
- production owner receipt path: 1 passed
- retained authority/privacy/canonicalization suite: 13 passed
- downstream guardian consumer: 1 passed
- lifecycle-soak binary compile check: passed
- strict runtime-kernel all-target Clippy: passed
- fresh independent exact-head review: PASS with no P0-P3 findings

## Non-claims
This PR does not alter the witness algorithm or receipt schema and does not claim birth, citizenship, governance, legal, or launch authority.
